huggingface.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
huggingface.summary: Robot-use Agents (RUAs) have shown promising zero-shot manipulation capabilities, but reliance on frontier, proprietary models limits research into further training. To democratize RUA research, we introduce uni-robot-agent, a unified harness for competitive open-weight robot use that supports further training. huggingface.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
huggingface.summary: Scaling computer-use agents from individual actions to complex software work requires experience that connects decisions to complete outcomes. We present NorthCUA, an integrated system for turbocharging computer-use agents through experience at scale. huggingface.summary: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. huggingface.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models

huggingface.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
huggingface.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. huggingface.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
huggingface.summary: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or a single fused mesh, while CHARM, the only generator of stylized hair cards, decodes a hairstyle autoregressively as a long sequence of control points. huggingface.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
huggingface.summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. huggingface.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
huggingface.summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. sorted_all.summary: The hair of stylized characters in games and avatars is built from hair cards: artist-placed ribbons whose geometry is the visible hair, animated by spring bones. sorted_all.title: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
sorted_all.summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. sorted_all.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
sorted_all.summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities.
